# openwrt_qos_reclassify (Resource)

A qos-scripts reclassification rule (`config reclassify`).

Manages a `reclassify` section in `/etc/config/qos`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.
- `target` (String) Target class. (UCI option `target`.)

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment. (UCI option `comment`.)
- `connbytes` (String) Connection bytes. (UCI option `connbytes`.)
- `direction` (String) Direction. (UCI option `direction`.)
- `dscp` (String) DSCP. (UCI option `dscp`.)
- `dsthost` (String) Destination host. (UCI option `dsthost`.)
- `dstports` (String) Destination ports. (UCI option `dstports`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `mark` (String) Mark. (UCI option `mark`.)
- `pktsize` (String) Packet size. (UCI option `pktsize`.)
- `portrange` (String) Port range. (UCI option `portrange`.)
- `ports` (String) Ports. (UCI option `ports`.)
- `proto` (String) Protocol. (UCI option `proto`.)
- `srchost` (String) Source host. (UCI option `srchost`.)
- `srcports` (String) Source ports. (UCI option `srcports`.)
- `tcpflags` (String) TCP flags. (UCI option `tcpflags`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
